title: Fourier coefficients of the low-degree part
statement: Let $n$ and $k$ be nonnegative integers, let $f$ be a real-valued function on the $n$-dimensional Boolean cube, and let $T$ be a finite set of its coordinates. The Fourier coefficient at $T$ of the sum of the Fourier terms of $f$ supported on sets of size at most $k$ equals the Fourier coefficient of $f$ at $T$ when $|T|\\le k$, and equals $0$ otherwise.
hypotheses_covered: $f$ is a real-valued function on the $n$-dimensional Boolean cube
$T$ is a finite set of coordinates in $\\{0,\\ldots,n-1\\}$
